newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan lowers Allegheny.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan lowers Allegheny.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he lowered his full-year 1997 estimate for Allegheny Teledyne Inc to $1.80 per share from $1.90.
-- Gambardella cited non-recurring costs in the second and third quarters.
-- He said those costs will be significantly lower than in the first quarter.
-- He said only $0.02 of the earnings forecast reduction was attributable to the company's operating profit line.
